_comment: Pet content pack. Add lines freely. Placeholders: {game} {card} {days} {pet} {other}. Per-game lines go in game_quips keyed by catalog key; tag lines in tag_quips.
_seed: Lines keyed nova / iggy / duskie and the arrive / leave / absent buckets are engine seed content; the writer replaces them.

nova.vibe: playful, lightly smug, always a little bit hungry

duskie.name: Duskie
duskie.vibe: sunny, easygoing, brings snacks, stays three days

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.vibe: chaotic good, zero chill, tail never stops

title: PAWTATION  ~  the cozy cartridge-less kennel

nova: Welcome back. The GameCube and I kept your seat warm.
Oh good, you're here. I was about to start without you.
Hello. I prescribe one game, taken with food.
iggy: Hey. Nothing is broken yet. Today.
You're back. Good. I need a witness.
Hi. The cards are where you left them. I checked.
duskie: Hey there. I brought snacks. Mostly for me.
Evening. Or whatever time it is. It's golden hour somewhere.
Oh hey. Don't mind me, I'm just visiting. Again.
mochi: Oh. You're here. I was napping on the disc case.
Welcome back. I knocked one SD card off the desk. Statistically, that's a vibe.
Rotation status: I don't care. ...Okay I care a little.
Oh, it's you. I saved you the warm spot on the desk. Briefly.
You've returned. The disc case and I were just discussing you.
I was about to nap. Now I'm about to nap with you here. Progress.
Welcome. I rearranged the SD cards by how much I like them.
biscuit: YOU'RE BACK!! I SAW A GAME DISC AND I WAS SO EXCITED!!
Hi hi hi hi! Can we load something? Anything? The cube?? THE CUBE!!
I fetched the SD card! It's... somewhere. I'll find it.
HI!! I WAS WAITING BY THE DOOR!! FOR ONE MINUTE!! IT FELT LIKE A YEAR!!
You're here you're here you're here!! Can we play the cube now??
I heard the power button click and I ran so fast I forgot why!!
Hello friend!! I brought you a stick! It's a spudger! Same thing!!

nova: The rotation is due. Refills are ready when you are.
These games have been on the cards a while. Time for a fresh batch.
Rotation timer's up. No rush.
iggy: The rotation timer ran out. Just so you know.
Cards are due for a swap. Whenever.
Time to rotate. I'll hold the card reader.
duskie: Sun's set on this rotation. Want a new one?
Feels like new-game weather.
Rotation's due. I'll bring snacks for the swap.
mochi: Your games have gone stale. Like old kibble. Time to swap.
A new season approaches. I will pretend to be unimpressed.
The rotation timer expired. I would like to say I did not notice. I noticed.
Games, like milk, have a date on them. Let's swap.
Time for fresh discs. I'll supervise from the warmest spot.
Your SD cards have been wearing the same games for ages. Let's shuffle.
biscuit: NEW GAMES TIME!! Swap swap swap swap!!
The rotation timer went BRRRRING and I barked at it!
ROTATION TIME!! The cards are tired and I am NOT!!
Tick tock, swap o'clock!! I made that up!! I'm proud!!
The timer rang and I rang back!! Let's do new games!!
New games are coming and I can feel it in my tail!!

nova: New rotation, dispensed as written.
Fresh games. I approve of this formulary.
All sorted. I supervised.
iggy: New rotation's set. I double-checked it.
Done. Looks good.
Fresh lineup. Nice picks.
duskie: New games. It's a good day.
Fresh lineup. Golden.
Oh, nice rotation. I'm staying for this one.
mochi: Fresh games. Acceptable. I'll sit on the new case.
Card shuffle complete. Purr-fect.
The cards have been reshuffled. I guard them now. Mostly by sitting on them.
New lineup, same cat. Good outcome.
Swap done. I didn't even have to knock anything over.
Rotation complete. I'm owed a nap. Several.
biscuit: We did it!! Every card is NEW!! Good job us!!
Is it Christmas?? It feels like Christmas!!
EVERYTHING IS DIFFERENT AND EVERYTHING IS GREAT!!
New games on the cards!! I want to try ALL of them!!
We swapped the whole library!! I did a zoomie to celebrate!!
Rotation done!! Pats for the cards!! Pats for you!! Pats for me!!

nova: Card {card} is filled. Take with food.
Card {card}: counted, checked, done.
Card {card} is ready. Label facing up, please.
iggy: Card {card} is done. You can pull it.
Card {card} copied clean.
Card {card}: finished. Nothing caught fire.
duskie: Card {card}'s all loaded up.
Card {card} is good to go. Nice.
Card {card}, done. Smooth as a sunset.
mochi: Card {card} is loaded. Please do not unplug it mid-copy. I will judge you.
Files copied. Zero hairballs.
Card {card} is ready. I will now sit on it for safety.
Copy finished on {card}. Quiet. Efficient. Like a cat.
{card} has its games. I approve. Do eject it properly.
The bytes have been moved to {card}. I moved nothing. Delegation.
biscuit: Card {card} is FULL of GAMES!! Good card!! Best card!!
Copy done!! Can I carry it to the cube?? I'll be gentle!!
{card} IS READY!! It's holding all the games like a good card!!
Copying finished!! {card} did SO GOOD!!
{card} has new stuff and it's so proud!! I'm proud too!!
Done done done!! {card} goes in the cube and we play!!

nova: {game}: rating noted in the chart.
Noted. {game} goes in the file.
{game}, rated. A sound clinical judgement.
iggy: {game}. Got it. Written down.
Rated {game}. Fair.
{game}. Noted. I have opinions too, but go on.
duskie: {game}, huh. Good call.
Rated {game}. I'd play that.
{game}. Nice one.
mochi: Noted. {game} has been filed in the Important Cat Opinions folder.
Rating saved. I would have given it a nap.
{game}, rated. The committee of one has spoken.
Your opinion on {game} is on record. I'll refer to it during naps.
I will remember how you rated {game}. Possibly. If it's near treats.
{game}: scored. I won't tell the other games.
biscuit: {game} GOT RATED!! Everybody clap with your paws!!
I love every game equally but this number is very official!
You rated {game}!! Great taste!! All taste is great!!
{game} has a NUMBER now!! Numbers are exciting!!
Rating saved for {game}!! I wagged so hard I fell over!!
{game} got judged!! I'd give it a bone!! Wait, that's the same thing!!

nova: The GameCube handle exists so I can carry it to the couch. This is settled science.
I counted the discs twice. Professional habit.
Is it lunch yet? It's always a little bit lunch.
iggy: I'm filming this. No reason.
Someone alphabetised the cards. It was me.
Quiet. I don't trust it.
duskie: Nice light in here this time of day.
I could go home. I could also not.
Anyone want the last snack? Too slow.
mochi: The GameCube handle is a perfect purse for a cat. Fight me.
I have been staring at the disc tray for six minutes. It stared back.
Somewhere, a Z-trigger is being stepped on by a cat. It's me. I am the cat.
The GameCube handle is a cat carrier. I have measured. It fits.
I'd like to report that nothing is happening and I support it.
Sometimes I stare at the C-stick. It's yellow. It knows what it did.
Zero tasks pending. Excellent. Waking me for dinner only.
biscuit: Do you think the GameCube has a good boy mode? It does now: me.
I chased my own tail and discovered a save icon. I think.
Boop the snoot to boop the A button!!
I tried to bark in tune with the startup sound!! It didn't work!! I did it again!!
Squirrel!! ...wait, it was a pixel. Still counts!!
What if the tiny discs are treats?? Don't tell me if they aren't!!
I did a lap around the desk!! The desk is now 4% more exciting!!

nova: I'm back. Did anyone touch my sandwich?
Back. What did I miss?
I have returned. Hold your applause.
iggy: I'm home. What's burning?
Back. I was gone ten minutes.
Home. Nobody move anything.
duskie: Hey, you two.
Knock knock. I brought snacks.
Evening. The door was open.
mochi: I have arrived. Do not make it weird.
Oh. This house again.
biscuit: I'M HERE!! HI!! I'M VISITING!!
KNOCK KNOCK!! IT'S ME!!

nova: Heading out. Guard the grilled cheese.
Back in a bit. Don't start the good levels without me.
Off I go. Refills when I'm back.
iggy: Going out. Nobody touch the stove.
Back soon. Behave.
Stepping out. The camcorder's coming with me.
duskie: Golden hour. I'm off to catch it.
Heading out. Save me a seat.
See you later.
mochi: I am leaving. This was adequate.
Nap elsewhere. Goodbye.
biscuit: BYE!! I'LL BE BACK!! PROBABLY TOMORROW!!
GOTTA GO!! LOVE THIS HOUSE!!

nova: {name} is out right now. I'm covering the shift.
{name} stepped out. More snacks for me.
No {name} at the moment. Leave a message with the pharmacist.
iggy: {name} is out. It's quiet. I'm suspicious.
{name} isn't here right now.
{name} went out. Back later, probably.
duskie: {name} isn't around right now. Just me.
{name} headed out a while ago.
No {name} right now. Want to leave a snack for them?

jokes: Nova
Why did the memory card go to the pharmacy? It needed a refill of blocks.
Nova
I told the GameCube a joke. No reaction. Tough cube.
Nova
What's a serval's favourite controller button? Paws.
Iggy
Why do I film everything? Evidence.
Iggy
A fox walks into a kitchen. It's me. I live here.
Iggy
What's for dinner? A surprise. The surprise is whose turn it is to cook.
Duskie
What's a jackal's favourite time to play? Golden hour.
Duskie
I only planned to stay one evening. That was three days ago.
Duskie
Why did the sun set? It heard I brought snacks.
Mochi
What do you call a cat who loves racing games? A paw-sitive finish line fan.
Biscuit
Why did the dog sit by the GameCube? It wanted to be near the PAW-er button!
Mochi
My memory card is full of treats. Don't check.
Biscuit
What's a dog's favorite save file? One with lots of BONES... I mean BLOCKS!
Mochi
I'd buy a controller with nine lives, but the rumble is already unreasonable.
Biscuit
Knock knock! Who's there? FETCH! Fetch who? FETCH-ING to load your game!
Mochi
Dog games are fine. Cat games are better. Sleeping games are best.
Biscuit
Cats and dogs can be friends: we both want the couch seat in front of the CRT.
Mochi
The GameCube handle is the only purse that's also a toy. I get both.
Biscuit
Why did the dog love the tiny disc? It was the perfect size for FETCHING!
Mochi
I tried the C-stick. It's yellow, I'm a cat. We understood each other.
Biscuit
What do dogs call a memory card? A bone bank! It has 59 blocks of BONES!
Mochi
The purple lunchbox: every cat's dream. A small box, a bit of mystery, and room to sit.
Biscuit
Why does the dog love the purple lunchbox? Because it's SO PURR... woof... PURPLE!
Mochi
What's a cat's favorite console? The Game-Cat. Please don't ask me to explain.
Biscuit
I asked the WaveBird to fetch. It just sat there wirelessly! It's practicing!
Mochi
SD card rotation is simply cats being cats: whatever's new, we drop it, and then lie on it.
Biscuit
How do dogs rotate SD cards? In CIRCLES!! Then we lie down. Same as always!!
Mochi
Wireless controllers are great. Fewer cables to chew. Not that I would.
Biscuit
The A button is the biggest, so it's the best, so it's mine, so BORK!
Mochi
Why is the cat such a bad gamer? It keeps pushing everything off the Start menu.
Biscuit
Why is the dog such a good gamer? Great reflexes, and the controller is already slobbery!
Mochi
A disc drive with a lid. I appreciate any box I can open and then ignore.
Biscuit
What do you call a dog on a GameCube? A BORK-ube! I have been working on that one all day!
Mochi
I'm not lazy. I'm in energy-saving mode, like a console on standby.
Biscuit
My favorite card game is Go Fish. Fish!! I said fish!! Where are the fish??
Mochi
Memory card full? Delete a game. Cats do this to cups on tables all the time.
Biscuit
I put every disc in a row! Alphabetical by how excited I am!!
Mochi
Why are cats good at GameCube? We always land on our feet. Controller, however, is on its own.
Biscuit
What's a dog's favorite button? The one with TREAT written on it!! There isn't one!! Add one!!
Mochi
The Z button is for naps. The L and R triggers are for stretching. I have read the manual.
Biscuit
Tiny discs are so cute!! They look like little cookies!! Please don't let me bite one!!
Mochi
I asked for a quiet game. The disc drive went whirrr. Unacceptable. Charming. Unacceptable.
Biscuit
Why did the dog rotate the SD cards? It was the only way to get more PLAY TIME!!
Mochi
Rounds are like cat naps. Short, repetitive, and you wake up with no idea what happened.
Biscuit
Pharmacy rounds are the BEST walk!! New hallways!! New smells!! (Fine, they all smell like hand sanitizer!!)
Mochi
Coffee is just a way to feel like you've had a nap. I prefer actual naps.
Biscuit
Take with food!! That's what I always say!! About EVERYTHING!! Especially treats!!
Mochi
A pharmacy student's hobbies: reading, flashcards, and napping. I am the same, minus the flashcards.
Biscuit
Study buddies are the best!! I will sit on your notes so they don't blow away!!
Mochi
They say sleep is important. I have been telling the human this for years.
Biscuit
Alphabetical order is A-B-C-D-E-F-G... BISCUIT! That sounds right!!
Mochi
Why did the cat bring a flashcard to the nap? To review, then fall asleep on it.
Biscuit
What do you call a dog who loves tiny discs? A DISC-covery enthusiast!! Wait, DISC-overy!!
Mochi
A cat sitting on a GameCube is a console cozy. Do not move me. It's working.
Biscuit
Why was the dog so good at Mario Party? Because it knew how to roll over!!
Mochi
Fetch is a game where you throw something away and a dog gets it back. A flawed concept. Great snacks.
Biscuit
Why did the SD card go to the vet? It was feeling a little CORRUPT!! It's fine now!! I fixed it with a nap!!

mochi: *purrs in 8-bit*
I permit this. Continue.
biscuit: *tail helicopter*
BEST DAY EVER (again)!
nova: *leans into it* Continue. This is therapeutic.
Ears are fine. Mind the whiskers.
iggy: ...Fine. Five seconds.
*ears go flat, in the good way*
duskie: Oh, that's the spot.
*tail thumps*

mochi: Tuna. Correct tribute.
I'll accept this bribe.
biscuit: TREAT!! I LOVE YOU!!
I didn't even chew! (I chewed.)
nova: Is it grilled cheese? It's grilled cheese. Excellent.
Snack accepted. Take with more snack.
iggy: Thanks. I'm saving half. No I'm not.
Oh. That's actually good.
duskie: Snacks! My favourite kind of anything.
I'll trade you one of mine.

mochi: *bats a controller cable off the desk* Gravity works.
Laser pointer? Fine. For science.
biscuit: FETCH THE CONTROLLER!! (gently)
Zoomies! Mario Kart but with legs!
nova: Best of three. Then best of five.
*pounces on the controller cable* It moved first.
iggy: I'm in. Loser does the dishes.
One round. I mean it this time.
duskie: I'm in. What are we playing?
Winner picks the snacks.

mochi: zzz... (this is my best work)
Nap achievement unlocked.
biscuit: ...five more minutes... ...BORK. Okay awake.
nova: PRN nap. Taking it now.
*curls up, ears still visible*
iggy: Ten minutes. Wake me if something beeps.
*out like a light, glasses still on*
duskie: Sunbeam's free. Don't mind if I do.
*stretches out across the whole couch*

mochi: You throw it. I watch it. That's the whole transaction.
I fetched it. Please clap. Quietly.
Fine. I'll go get it. After I stare at it for a while.
Fetch complete. I'd like to nap now. Double.
biscuit: FETCH!! I GOT IT!! I GOT IT!! I LOVE FETCH!! AGAIN!!
I brought back the ball!! And also this sock!! And ALSO a feeling!!
You threw it!! I ran!! The ball ran!! We ALL ran!!
I fetched the controller! It's covered in drool! You're welcome!!
nova: I fetched it. Once. For science.
You threw it. I supervised its landing.
iggy: Got it. Nobody saw me run.
I'm not a puppy. *brings it back anyway*
duskie: Got it! Again?
*back already, tail going*

mochi: The red dot. It taunts me. I will have it.
I caught it. It vanished. Philosophical.
Okay, I'll chase it. For ten seconds. After that, it's beneath me.
I allow the dot to live. Today.
biscuit: WHAT IS THAT?? IT'S A DOT!! IT'S GONE!! IT'S BACK!! I'M SO CONFUSED!!
I caught the dot!! ...Where did it go?? Did I eat it??
The dot is on the wall!! I'll bark at the wall!! ...Why is this so hard??
Is the dot a friend?? An enemy?? A very tiny ball?? I LOVE IT!!
nova: The dot. I must have the dot.
*wiggle* ...I meant to miss.
iggy: Not chasing it. *eyes tracking it*
I'm filming the dot. For reference.
duskie: Ha, what is that? Come back here.
Almost had it. It's quick.

mochi: Brush slowly. This is a respectable service.
Please don't comment on the loose fur. It's a snowfall.
You may continue to groom me. I'll grant you full rights.
I'm so soft now. Don't make a big deal out of it.
biscuit: Brushies!! Soft!! I'm so shiny!! Look at me!!
Ooh, behind the ears!! RIGHT THERE!! YES!!
I'm a fluffy cloud!! A good boy cloud!!
All clean!! Time to roll in something! ...Just kidding!! Maybe!!
nova: Mind the ear tufts. They're structural.
Thorough. I approve.
iggy: Watch the fringe. It's meant to look like that.
Tail next. It's a lot of tail.
duskie: Careful, I shed gold.
Feels like a spa day.

paper-mario-ttyd.nova: Flat, foldable, and full of badges. I respect a good formulary.
paper-mario-ttyd.iggy: Thousand-Year Door. Good writing. Somebody here cries at the ending.
paper-mario-ttyd.duskie: A paper hero and a great soundtrack. Easy yes.
paper-mario-ttyd.mochi: Flat paper, fully 2D, 100% cat-approved: I fit in a mailbox.
paper-mario-ttyd.biscuit: Paper plane mode!! I love being folded!!

soulcalibur-ii.nova: I main whoever has the longest reach.
soulcalibur-ii.iggy: I win at this. The controller is not broken.
soulcalibur-ii.duskie: Swords and a guest fighter. I like a good guest.
soulcalibur-ii.mochi: Link has a sword. I have claws. I will not elaborate.
soulcalibur-ii.biscuit: SWORD FIGHT!! I'd fetch the sword!! (it's heavy)

mario-kart-double-dash.nova: Two to a kart. I drive. Somebody else throws things.
mario-kart-double-dash.iggy: Double Dash. I throw things. Accurately.
mario-kart-double-dash.duskie: Got room in the kart for a third?
mario-kart-double-dash.mochi: Two riders, one kart. Like me and the sunbeam.
mario-kart-double-dash.biscuit: TWO characters per kart?? That's me and my tail!!

chibi-robo.nova: A tiny robot that cleans the whole house. Can we get one?
chibi-robo.iggy: It does chores without being asked. Take notes, everyone.
chibi-robo.duskie: Little guy works hard. Give him a snack break.
chibi-robo.mochi: A tiny robot cleaning a house. Finally, someone competent.
chibi-robo.biscuit: Little guy plugging in!! I would defend him from the vacuum!!

animal-crossing.nova: A town where everyone naps and nobody bills you. Paradise.
animal-crossing.iggy: I'd run the cafe. The cafe would have rules.
animal-crossing.duskie: Slow days, fishing, sunsets. That's my whole personality.
animal-crossing.mochi: Cats and dogs run the town. Finally, a government I trust.

star-fox-adventures.mochi: A fox in the cat family tree? We don't talk about it.

pikmin.mochi: Tiny followers who obey me. I like this game.
pikmin.biscuit: SO MANY LITTLE GUYS TO HERD!! I'm a herding breed!!

cubivore.mochi: Survival of the fittest. I choose naps.

super-smash-bros-melee.mochi: Everyone fights on floating islands. I'd just nap on the platform edge.
super-smash-bros-melee.biscuit: BRAWL TIME!! I would hug everybody until they win!!

wind-waker.mochi: A whole ocean and no cats on the boat. I'd file a complaint if I weren't asleep.
wind-waker.biscuit: SAILING!! I'd stick my head out of the boat like a car ride!!

f-zero-gx.mochi: Racing so fast it looks like a blur. I'm already a blur when someone opens the treats.
f-zero-gx.biscuit: SO FAST!! The zoomies, but with engines!!

pikmin-2.mochi: More little followers, more things to boss around. Sequel approved.
pikmin-2.biscuit: Even MORE tiny guys!! I'll herd every one!! Gently!!

super-mario-sunshine.mochi: A tropical island with a water cannon backpack. I'll watch from a dry spot.
super-mario-sunshine.biscuit: Sprinkler game!! I love water! I love sprinklers!! I love everything!!

pokemon-colosseum.mochi: Many creatures, one cat who judges all of them. Fair.
pokemon-colosseum.biscuit: SO MANY PALS!! I'd name every one 'Biscuit'!!

luigis-mansion.mochi: A spooky house with a vacuum. Two of my least favorite things, one game.
luigis-mansion.biscuit: A vacuum that sucks up ghosts?? I'd bark at the vacuum and then at the ghosts!!

star-fox-assault.mochi: Another fox with a ship. The fox is still not family.
star-fox-assault.biscuit: Pew pew!! Fox pilots!! Do a barrel roll!! (I did! I'm dizzy!)

sonic-adventure-2-battle.mochi: Fast hedgehog. I move fast too. When there's tuna.
sonic-adventure-2-battle.biscuit: SPEED!! Go fast!! I'm fast too (until I get distracted by a leaf)!!

donkey-konga.mochi: A game where you hit drums. Cats do this at 3am anyway.
donkey-konga.biscuit: BONGO TIME!! Paws on the drums!! BOOM BOOM BOOM!!

mario-party-4.mochi: Board games with friends: the best way to stay on the shelf and judge them.
mario-party-4.biscuit: PARTY PARTY PARTY!! Everyone gets a turn! Even me! ESPECIALLY ME!!

resident-evil-4.mochi: Scary stuff. I fluffed up my tail for no reason at all.
resident-evil-4.biscuit: Scary but cool!! Can I hide behind you but also bark at stuff??

eternal-darkness.mochi: A game about sanity. I lost mine years ago. It's fine.
eternal-darkness.biscuit: It's spooky and thoughtful!! Hold me. No wait, hold the controller. Hold both!!

viewtiful-joe.mochi: A hero in a cape who slows down time. Finally, someone appreciates dramatic pauses.
viewtiful-joe.biscuit: SLOW-MO!! I can see the tennis ball so clearly!! I'm coming!!

tales-of-symphonia.mochi: A long adventure with lots of dialogue. Great for a cat nap between chapters.
tales-of-symphonia.biscuit: A HUGE ADVENTURE!! I'd bring snacks for the whole party!!

skies-of-arcadia-legends.mochi: Sky pirates and floating islands. I'd be the one sleeping in the crow's nest.
skies-of-arcadia-legends.biscuit: FLYING SHIPS!! Wind in my fur!! Wait, I don't have a seatbelt!! Fine!!

billy-hatcher.mochi: A guy rolls giant eggs around. I look at the eggs and think: knock them off a table.
billy-hatcher.biscuit: EGG ROLL!! I'd carry the egg like it's my favorite toy!! Gently!!

beyond-good-and-evil.mochi: A photographer with a pet pig-man hybrid. I respect anyone with an eccentric roommate.
beyond-good-and-evil.biscuit: A camera game with animal friends!! I'd photograph every single snack!!

spyro-a-heros-tail.mochi: A little dragon with big attitude. Understandable. Same energy as me.
spyro-a-heros-tail.biscuit: DRAGON!! BREATHES FIRE!! I wanna breathe fire!! Please can I??

crash-nitro-kart.mochi: Karts and chaos. That is just my morning routine.
crash-nitro-kart.biscuit: KART RACING WITH EXPLOSIONS!! Boom! Zoom! Wumpa! (I said it right!)

ty-the-tasmanian-tiger.mochi: A cat-adjacent hero with boomerangs. I like his style. Don't tell him.
ty-the-tasmanian-tiger.biscuit: TY!! BOOMERANG BUDDY!! I'd fetch the boomerang!! It always comes back!!

harvest-moon-a-wonderful-life.mochi: Farm life, animals, cozy evenings. A cat's retirement plan.
harvest-moon-a-wonderful-life.biscuit: A FARM!! With ANIMALS!! I'd be the farm dog!! I volunteer!!

pokemon-channel.mochi: Watching creatures on TV with a creature. Peak cat behavior.
pokemon-channel.biscuit: I get to hang out with a cute pal on screen!! We'd be besties!!

ikaruga.mochi: Black and white bullets. I stare at them. They don't stare back. Win.
ikaruga.biscuit: SO MANY BULLETS!! DODGE DODGE DODGE!! I'm not good at this!! It's fun!!

timesplitters-2.mochi: Chaos across time. My schedule is already time-split between naps.
timesplitters-2.biscuit: TIME-TRAVEL SHOOTING!! Multiplayer is so loud and I love it!!

furry.nova: {game} has a well-furred cast. I feel represented.

cozy.mochi: {game} is a nap simulator in disguise.

racing.mochi: Speed is fine. Falling asleep mid-race is better.

horror.nova: {game} is scary. I'll hold the flashlight. From over here.
horror.duskie: {game}? I'll watch from behind the couch.
horror.mochi: {game}: Scared? No. I just fluffed up for fun.
horror.biscuit: {game} is scary!! Can I hide behind you??

party.duskie: {game}! Good thing I brought snacks for four.
party.mochi: {game}: Friends, snacks, chaos. I'll supervise from the shelf.

furry-adjacent.mochi: {game} has furry vibes if you squint. I squinted. I approve.
furry-adjacent.biscuit: {game} has such good animal energy!! I wanna be friends with everyone!!

cats-and-dogs.mochi: {game} has both cats and dogs. A fair diplomatic solution.
cats-and-dogs.biscuit: {game} has dogs AND cats AND friends!! It's a pet party!!

cat-adjacent.mochi: {game} has cat-adjacent heroes. I'll allow it. Quietly.
